Foxconn August Sales Rise on AI Demand

Foxconn reported August sales of USD 29.14 billion, a figure attributed to the boom in artificial intelligence (AI) demand. This represents the second-highest monthly sales in the company's history. The highest monthly sales were recorded in July, reaching USD 29.85 billion.
